result.summary: Found 3 issues related to text truncation and content layout in this food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramei' appears truncated, likely should read 'Tokumaru Ramen' but is cut off at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text containers accommodate full restaurant names or add ellipsis handling that doesn't cut mid-word.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge, showing partial text and image, which may confuse users about content boundaries.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll carousels, but ensure a visual affordance (partial peek or arrow) clearly signals scrollability.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the ramen card (Popular right now) has a white background circle while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment across all cards for consistency.
